name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.7 Timeline Playhead Placement, True Icon Sizing & Asset Name Tooltips!
• Playhead Timeline Placement: Assets are now placed precisely at the active Timeline Indicator / Playhead position in both After Effects and Premiere Pro!
• True Icon Size: Assets now scale to the exact pixel size you choose in Settings or Customizer, maintaining razor-sharp vector fidelity.
• Asset Name Tooltips: Hovering over any card or [+] button now clearly shows the real name of the icon, image, or emoji instead of generic text.
• Full Drag & Drop: Dragging from panel directly into After Effects or Premiere Pro inserts the asset at your playhead and auto-sorts it into your 'Icons' project bin.
• Zero API Keys: Completely clean Settings drawer with zero key configuration required.
